lines.text: And unclean, sin was stained on me, and shame was running deep.

lines.text: But love was spilled on Calvary. Oh, hallelujah, I'm clean. God, how can it be? I'm ransomed and redeemed and standing in your victory.

lines.text: It's not what I have done, but what you've done for me.

lines.text: You paid it all upon that tree. Oh, hallelujah, I'm clean. Your love has overcome and your mercy is supreme. I'm dancing in Your victory. Oh, hallelujah!

lines.text: 'Cause you took away my shame and you nailed it to the cross. You got me running out the grave. Oh, hallelujah, here I come. 'Cause you took away my shame and you nailed it to the cross.

lines.text: Oh, we took it away. Oh, you took away my shame when you nailed it to that old rugged cross. Got me running out.
lines.text_sk: Ach, vzali sme to preč. Ach, vzal si preč moju hanbu, keď si ju pribil na ten starý, drsný kríž. Dal si mi rozbehnúť sa.

lines.text: Oh, hallelujah, hero!

lines.text: Because he took away your shame and he nailed it to the cross. Panic turned reality. Hallelujah, here I come! Sing hallelujah, here I come! Hallelujah, here I come! I'm not depressed anymore. My anxiety left me. It's you between everybody. Jump, jump, jump, run!

lines.text: Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Thank you, Jesus!

lines.text: Come on, you say! 'Cause I've been washed in the water, washed in the blood, I'm as good as new.
